questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code maps failures to HTTP status codes? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A client sends amountMinor as "0". What response does it get?
Why does the handler use 409 rather than 422 for InsufficientFundsError?
choices: Because 422 is reserved for JSON parse errors
Because express rejects 422 for POST routes
Because the request is well formed but conflicts with the current state of the account, and could succeed later if the balance changes
Because 409 tells the client to retry immediately

questions.prompt: What does a successful POST /transfers response include besides the JSON body?
choices: A Location header pointing to /transfers/<transferId> and status 201
Only status 200 with no headers set
An ETag header derived from the balance
